title: Wake-triggered exclusive microphone handoff and Realtime connection
goal: Prove that a saved wake transfers exclusive microphone ownership from Python to the armed browser, reaches one connected Realtime session, then stops and restores wake listening without a user question.
preconditions: BACKEND=realtime is configured with a usable OpenAI credential and network connection.
The loopback Realtime host is launched and Arm hands-free audio has been clicked once.
A private local wake fixture has already been recorded.

evidence.offline: The same deterministic oracle evaluates sanitized lifecycle reports without microphone, browser, network, credentials, audio, or wall-clock sleeps.
evidence.live_host: The runner automatically replays the existing private wake fixture, observes exclusive handoff and connection, then performs bounded cleanup; no fresh human speech is required.
